description: One loaded source for each side of a set of pinned IANA/JDK equivalences that discriminate: he (vs iw), id (vs in), yi (vs ji), cmn (vs zh-cmn and zh-guoyu), yue (vs zh-yue), tlh (vs i-klingon), nan (vs zh-min-nan and zh-nan), jbo (vs art-lojban), ase (vs sgn-US and sgn-ase). MEASURED: only cmn collapses onto a shared canonical language code (zh) and it is alone there, so no tiebreakers are required and the fixture builds. zh itself is deliberately NOT loaded; browser-chooser-canonical-collision is the contrasting fixture where it is.
